primary_model.selection_rule: fixed by pre-registration; a secondary configuration scoring higher may not displace it

confirmatory_arms.rule: A is the primary number. B and C are reported alongside it and may never be substituted for it.

A_primary_confirmatory.partition_source: loaded from the cohort record at run time by confirmatory_policy.load_cohort_record; never hard-coded in the driver

B_full_77_loso_descriptive.tier: descriptive only -- the development-exposed subjects are inside this evaluation

C_secondary_confirmatory.tier: LOSO within the outcome-unseen cohort; cohort peers are in every training fold, so this is not an untouched external holdout

primary_names: Extension of index and middle, flexion of the others
Flexion of ring and little finger, extension of the others
Thumb opposing base of little finger
class_vocabulary.excluded: exercise-C object grasps and exercise-B wrist/forearm movements

representations.policy: all three reported side by side; canonical16 is primary; none is used to select or tune the primary model

extraction_rule.rule: split each labelled repetition into thirds; take the MEDIAN of the central third
extraction_rule.tuning: segmentation boundaries are never tuned per class or per accuracy

drift_correction.method: per-subject drift trajectory estimated from REST blocks only (labelled-free), median rest posture per block, offsets relative to the first block, linearly interpolated over normalised session time, subtracted
drift_correction.role: falsification control; the primary result is reported uncorrected

normalization.excluded_by_policy: per-subject normalisation of test subjects (requires subject-specific calibration a deployed decoder would not have)

metrics.companion: balanced accuracy (classes are balanced by design)

cohort_definitions.policy: machine-derived; never hand-edited. The final report must distinguish A primary untouched/outcome-unseen holdout evidence, B full-77 LOSO descriptive evidence, and C secondary/exploratory comparisons -- these are not equally confirmatory.

identity_assertions.identity_authority: DB9 archive slot; the in-file `subject` field is provenance metadata only
